i18n.enTitle: Risks that can be prevented with internal rules and systems that can be prevented based on 18 cases of generated AI that have been published in Japan
i18n.enSummary: Articles about information leaks from generative AI often cite cases from overseas. On the other hand, what kinds of cases have been made public in Japan, and in what form?
